description:
Move glasses.ts strings (loading/ready lines, menu labels, Save audio on/off, Add marker, Stop and summarize, hints, degraded-state text like "Saving — processing later", captions-unavailable/not-downloaded lines, status line) to the catalog.
- Write short Japanese variants that fit G2_MENU_LABEL_MAX_BYTES and TEXT_LIMIT at 3 bytes/char; add a test asserting every glasses message in every locale fits its budget (with max-length params such as service names and speaker short names).
- truncateUtf8 must not cut inside a grapheme cluster (check Intl.Segmenter).
- Re-render the glasses page when the UI language changes.
Apply the fallback chosen in the spike if the G2 can't render some characters.
title: Glasses UI: localize G2 strings within byte budgets
